Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment used co-immunoprecipitation (AP-MS) to analyze the interactome of iRhom2. The acquisition was explicitly stated as data-dependent (DDA) and quantification was label-free (LFQ).

scope: co-IPs were used for mass spectrometry measurements.

Transfected cells (iRhom2 wt-3xHA, iRhom 2 mutant-3xHA and empty GFP (as the control)) were lysed and the protein lysates were subjected to immunoprecipitation using an       -HA antibody, employing a standard IP protocol.
The dried beads from the individual IPs were then processed for MS-analysis as described previously.
